_doc: Which Cockpit section (portfolio) each thing appears in. Sections: ai-thrival, micropace, investments, research, family. Unlisted boards go to defaultGroup. channels = gateway platforms to show (empty = all). lanes = worker lanes to check. utilityPortal = the separate Utility Portal app: Cockpit reads its home page and lists every tool found there in the sidebar (a new tool added to the portal appears by itself). links = other tools shown in the sidebar, one group per `group` name, placed before Operations (each opens in a new tab; add a line per tool function). dashboardUrl = link to the Hermes dashboard from the header ({host} = page hostname; publish with: tailscale serve --bg --https=9443 9119). allowedHosts = hostnames Cockpit may be reached by besides localhost. people = who has their own view: the devices (tailnet machine names) and addresses they use, and the portfolios hidden from them; every other tailnet device is Frank, and a device tailscale does not know is always a Guest. Lane models live in lanes/models.conf.
